tutorial.intro: Welcome to Dou Dizhu! One player becomes the Landlord and fights against two Peasants.
tutorial.bidPhase: Bid 1-3 to become the Landlord, or pass. The highest bidder gets the kitty cards.
tutorial.playPhase: Play card combinations to empty your hand first. Bombs and rockets beat everything!
tutorial.combos: Singles, pairs, trios, straights, consecutive pairs, airplanes — learn the combos to win!

hintReason.playLowest: Play your lowest card to conserve strong cards
hintReason.bomb: Use a bomb to take control

combo.notCombo: Not a valid combination — check your selection
combo.noBeat: This combo cannot beat the current table play
